versions.changelog:
video-extend-edit 2.0.0

- Requires ofox-video-core version 2.0.0 or newer; older cores will not work and are explicitly rejected.
- Now passes the --approved flag in all real-run commands to align with new API spend gating.
- Removed legacy or outdated documentation (skill-card.md).
- Updated documentation and instructions for compatibility and safe usage with core changes.

video-extend-edit 1.3.1

- Confirms with direct measurement that Ofox's API accepts and ignores the "mode" field; attempts to use it result in plain text-to-video jobs without error.
- Clarifies that no content-editing or "extend mode" route exists; the existing mechanism (extracting a frame, generating a new segment, and joining) is the only supported way to extend a video.
- Updates documentation to explain why "edit" or "extend" modes should not be presented as rejected—the API silently discards them.
- Removes legacy/obsolete file: skill-card.md.

video-extend-edit 1.1.0

- Updated version metadata to 1.1.0.
- Expanded documentation to clarify join process and multi-segment handling.
- Added new real-world test cases and examples in SKILL.md for more aspect ratios and multi-segment jobs.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Improved coverage of frame extraction and video dimension behaviors.

- Clarified that this skill extends or replaces the ending of an existing video clip using a frame from the original video.
- Specified that it does not support editing content within the video or altering its middle sections—only continuation or tail replacement is possible.
- Added detailed instructions on prerequisite setup, including dependency checks for ffmpeg and the core skill directory resolution.
- Documented behavior regarding input frame aspect ratios: custom or non-standard shapes are accepted, and the output segment’s resolution is determined by the model, not the input.
- Expanded on usage scenarios, limitations, and guidance on when not to use the skill.
